name: Calamus
desc: Calamus is a member of [The Hive](faction:the_hive). They are a guardian of [Greathive Aratel](location:greathive_aratel), sworn to protect the [Lordsgrove](location:the_lordsgrove) and [The Valley](location:the_starswept_valley).
additional_info: -   The player used to be able to assists Calamus in defending Greathive from threats, for which they would reward them with a chest. This included: Alpha Megalodaunt, Authority Captain, Brainsucker, Deep Widow, King Thresher, Stone Knight, Thresher.
